<!-- pr-reviewer: e5c9d65211f7a7bda9c2b29d6bed293252193448 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The review found no blocking items.

- The MCP guide describes the optional operation `notes` array, its string values, and its omission when empty.
- The guide distinguishes informational notes from blocking warnings and points to the verification verdict.
- The module comment describes band checks, corner checks, stock clipping, and noise filters. These descriptions match the existing code.
- Issue #2512 permits recorded decisions. The decision file covers both large modules and the stock-outline selection.
- The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local results, with a trial merge against upstream/main at `37bde5e9af529249fb82d0f6a787f9defc74ab1c`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge | Passed without conflicts |
| MCP skill Python tests | 3 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run -j 6` | Passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib -j 6` | 434 passed, 10 ignored, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `git diff --check upstream/main` | Passed |

I independently reran both documentation mutations. Each test read the exact upstream file through an in-memory substitution. No tracked file was edited.

- Upstream MCP guide: the notes documentation test failed for both tool rows. The PR text passed after the substitution ended.
- Upstream `unreached.rs`: the module documentation test failed. The PR text passed after the substitution ended.

This PR changes no executable Rust, posted G-code, geometry behavior, collision checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved. No UI files changed.

The gate dry run included upstream changes because the local trial merge was not committed. I used the PR diff to select the checks above. I did not run the full quick gate, a GUI session, a physical machine, or the ignored heavy tests. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
